factCards.text: The Drag Me Down video was filmed at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston in 2015, among training mock-ups, spacesuits and a rover.
Danny DeVito appears in the Steal My Girl video as the director trying to organise a desert set that also holds ballerinas, a marching band and a sumo wrestler.

factCards.text: You & I was filmed on Clevedon Pier in Somerset, a Victorian iron pier that is Grade I listed.
factCards.sourceTitle: Widely reported at the time of the 2014 shoot; pier trust records not consulted
